text:
jordan-cs: FYI — Acme sent a SOC2 evidence request asking for our SBOM + timeline for remediating a transitive CVE their compliance team flagged. They also want confirmation that KMS key rotation won't break deploys. Need an ETA to share by EOD.

mira: ack. Do we have the CVE id and which component/version it affects?

tracy: forwarded the customer's note: they referenced a flagged dependency in our runtime container -> package `libyaml` (transitive via `config-loader`) CVE-2026-12345. Sec-scan flagged moderate-high, exploitability = low.

sec-bot: automated-scan report attached: summary: CVE-2026-12345; affected images: inference-runtime:1.12.3, optimizer:0.9.x; patch available in libyaml 0.3.7. Suggested action: update transitive dep and rebuild images.

mira: thanks. Action items: (1) confirm whether any hosted instances still run the vulnerable image, (2) draft SBOM and provenance notes, (3) give customer patch window options.

devops-nate: quick inventory: only a small fraction of legacy Dedicated pools still on inference-runtime:1.12.3 (~6 dedicated hosts, flagged by tag). Hosted pools already on 1.13.x. We can push rebuilt images with patched transitive dep and do a rolling rollout for hosted within 48 hours. Dedicated customers will need scheduled maintenance — estimate 3–5 days depending on region and customer approval.

mira: for the SBOM: we already have a BOM snapshot in S3 for the affected versions. Link: https://internal.s3.redwood/sbom/inference-runtime/1.12.3/sbom.json. Include commit hashes & build metadata. I'll prepare a short cover note for SOC2 that explains transitive exposure and our mitigation steps.

paul-sre: KMS rotation question: rotating the service key used by the deploy pipeline will not affect runtime decrypts — runtime uses customer-scoped keys via KMS proxy. But rotating the build/signing key requires coordinated rebuilds. For Acme's ask, confirm we will not rotate customer keys as part of this patch.

jordan-cs: customer explicitly asked: "will you rotate any keys or change RBAC that could impact our integrations?" — they want assurance we won't break their SSO agents.

mira: answer: we will not change customer KMS keys or RBAC during the remediation. Only rebuild and redeploy patched images. We'll provide a rollback plan and can perform the upgrade in a canary-first rollout.

devops-nate: proposed remediation timeline to share with customer: Hosted (Redwood API): canary deploy within 12 hrs, full rollout in 48 hrs. Dedicated (reserved pools): coordinate maintenance window — earliest slot 72–120 hrs depending on customer-approved window. For Private/VPC customers we will provide a patch bundle + instructions; estimated time to remediate on their side varies.

tracy: does the rebuild require configuration changes or just a CMS dep bump? If it's only a transitive bump we can automate image rebuilds and CI will verify.

mira: it's a dep bump + re-run of the quantization pipeline — automated but CI takes ~30–45 mins per image. No infra config changes.

jordan-cs: customer follow-up: they asked for an explicit remediation SLA and whether we can sign a commitment for this CVE. Any legal ask?

paul-sre: we can offer an ETA and evidence (rebuilt SBOM, deploy logs, CVE tracker entry) but not a formal SLA amendment for ad-hoc CVEs. Suggest: provide a remediation plan and an acceptance checklist they can sign.

mira: I'll draft the email and the evidence package: SBOM link, build logs, CVE tracker entry, PR link, and canary deployment timestamps.

tracy: assigning tasks: Mira — draft evidence + customer note (ETA tonight). Nate — schedule rebuilds and prepare canary rollout plan. Paul — write short note on KMS/RBAC assurance. Jordan — send to Acme when ready.

jordan-cs: thanks all. I'll tell Acme: Hosted: canary in 12h, full in 48h; Dedicated: earliest 72–120h depending on their maintenance window; we will not rotate customer KMS keys or change RBAC. Will include SBOM and build provenance.

mira: added one more: we'll create a minimal remediation ticket in the public tracker for visibility and link it in the customer note.

paul-sre: also adding post-deploy monitoring to watch latency/error signals for 24h after rollout — will put alerts on the deploy job.

jordan-cs: perfect. I'll close the loop with Acme and paste the evidence when ready. :thumbsup:

sec-bot: ticket created: SEC-2026-4827. CI rebuilds queued.
